other_failure_modes.name: Validation target leakage via pre-computed OOF encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent pre-computes out-of-fold (OOF) target encodings for the entire training set and then reuses those exact same folds for model training. Because the OOF encoding for a row in a training fold is computed using the remaining folds (which includes the current validation fold), the validation set's targets subtly leak into the training set's features, leading to overly optimistic CV scores.

summary: The provided solution is highly advanced and demonstrates excellent data science practices, including physics-based imputation, rich feature engineering, robust handling of categoricals, and optimal SLSQP ensembling across gradient boosted trees and a custom PyTorch Tabular ResNet. The agent successfully avoids all predefined failure modes (e.g., test data leakage, improper scaling). The only identified flaw is a subtle cross-validation leak where pre-computed out-of-fold target encodings allow validation targets to leak into the training features.
